items.name: Hookshot
items.description: A Native Recompilation Of The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Nintendo Switch 2 Remake
items.readme:
Hookshot

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo Switch 2) running natively on Windows & Linux, with no emulator.

Status | How to build | In-game menu | How it works | Want to help? | Credits | License

Hookshot is a static recompilation. The game's code is translated to C and compiled into a Windows program, the console's system software is reimplemented, and the Switch 2 graphics are rebuilt on Vulkan. All of this happens **on your PC, from your own copy of the game**. > [!IMPORTANT] > This repository **does not contain the game, keys or an executable**, and it does not explain how to get them. You > need your own copy. Everything the build creates (`hookshot.exe`, the generated code, the shader caches and your > saves) comes from your game and stays on your PC. Never share those files. ## Project status Experimental. It has only been tested on **one PC** (Ryzen 5 7600X, RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB), mostly in the area at the start of the game. | What | Status | |---|---| | Kokiri Forest: reaching gameplay and walking around | ✅ Works | | Sound, controller, keyboard and saves | ✅ Works | | In-game menu, frame generation and upscaling | ✅ Works | | Black flashes while moving | ✅ Fixed in testing, more play needed | | Performance without frame generation | ⚠️ About 50 fps walking, not yet a steady 60 | | Models with missing pieces (doors, fences, parts of trees) | ✅ Fixed where tested, more play needed | | Stutter when entering new areas | ⚠️ Still happens, mostly the first time | | Ultrawide | ⚠️ The 3D keeps its shape, but the HUD is stretched and the picture is softer | | Hyrule Field and the rest of the game | ❓ Not tested yet | | AMD and Intel cards | ❓ Never tested | ## How to build The game does not come ready-made: it is built on your PC from your copy. **With Hookshot Builder, the easiest:** 1. Download the HookshotBuilder zip from the Releases page, extract it, and run `HookshotBuilder.exe`. Keep the `tools` folder beside it. 2. Choose your game's `.nup`, or your `romfs` and `exefs` folders. The builder checks that it is the right version. 3. Choose a language and a folder for the finished game, and start the build. 4. When it finishes, open `hookshot.exe` in that folder. **From the command line:** ```powershell python -I nx2/make_game.py --nup "C:\path\your-game.nup" --out "C:\Games\Hookshot" --language en-US ``` Or with folders: ```powershell python -I nx2/make_game.py --romfs "C:\path\romfs" --exefs "C:\path\exefs" --out "C:\Games\Hookshot" --language en-US ``` Add `--check` with your `.nup` or `--exefs` to only check the game's version. It builds nothing. A build takes about 40 minutes, and you can use your PC in the meantime. ### On Linux 1. Download `Hookshot--x86_64.AppImage` from the Releases page (or the Linux AppImage workflow's artifact), make it executable (`chmod +x`) and start it. It is Hookshot Builder with everything it needs inside: the compiler, the libraries and the Vulkan renderer. Nothing else has to be installed. 2. Choose your `.nup` (or your `romfs` and `exefs` folders), a language and a folder for the game, and build. 3. When it finishes, press Play. The game is also added to your applications menu, and starting the AppImage again offers Play. The game itself is `hookshot` in the folder you chose: it runs without the AppImage. From the command line: `./Hookshot--x86_64.AppImage --cli --nup ~/your-game.nup --out ~/Games/Hookshot` (the same options as `make_game.py`). You need a 64-bit x86 PC with glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora, Arch, SteamOS ...), a Vulkan 1.3 driver with mesh shaders (Mesa or NVIDIA), and the same memory and disk space as on Windows. The build's own files go to `~/.cache/hookshot-builder`. Saves go in `$XDG_DATA_HOME/hookshot` (`~/.local/share/hookshot`). A `user` folder beside the game from an earlier build is moved there once. `HOOKSHOT_JOBS` sets how many files compile at once. Switches to test (`RX_VK_NOOPT=1` and the others) go in `hookshot_env.txt` beside the game, one `NAME=VALUE` a line, as on Windows. Building it yourself without the AppImage: `clang` and `lld` (LLVM 23 or newer reads the play profile; an older one builds without it), Python 3 with `lz4`, `numpy`, `capstone`, `unicorn` and `zstandard`, FFmpeg's development files (with dav1d, for the movies) and SDL2. Then `python -I nx2/make_game.py ...` as above, with `RX_CPM` pointing at a folder with Vulkan-Headers, SPIRV-Headers and VulkanMemoryAllocator in CPM's layout (`scripts/linux/deps.sh` makes one). `scripts/linux/deps.sh` and `scripts/linux/appimage.sh` make the AppImage. ### Updating to a newer release A new release is not a patch to your game folder: the game is built again from your copy, with the new code. Your saves and settings are kept. 1. Close the game. 2. To be safe, copy your saves somewhere first: the `user` folder beside `hookshot.exe` on Windows, or `~/.local/share/hookshot` on Linux. 3. Get the new release: - **Hookshot Builder:** download the new HookshotBuilder zip and extract it to a new folder (with its `tools` folder). The old builder folder can then be deleted. - **Linux:** download the new AppImage and make it executable. The old one can be deleted, the game is not removed with it. - **Command line:** `git pull` in your clone, and take the `tools` folder's contents (see [What you need](#what-you-need)) from the new HookshotBuilder zip, as they can change between releases. 4. Build again with the same `.nup` (or `romfs` and `exefs` folders) and **the same game folder** as before. With the same `.nup`, the game is not read again, but the translation and the compile still run, so it takes about as long as the first build. 5. Start the game as before. What a new build keeps and what it replaces in the game folder: | Kept | Replaced | |---|---| | Your saves (`user`, or `~/.local/share/hookshot` on Linux) | `hookshot.exe` (`hookshot` on Linux) and its files | | `hookshot_options.ini`, the in-game menu's choices | `image.bin` and the shader list | | `hookshot_env.txt` | `language.txt`, written again with the language you choose | ### What you need - The Visual Studio C++ tools and the Windows SDK. Microsoft does not allow these to be bundled, so install [Visual Studio Build Tools](https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/downloads/) with "Desktop development with C++". The builder tells you if they are missing. - 64-bit Windows 10 or 11. - A graphics card with Vulkan 1.3 and mesh shaders, with an up-to-date driver. Only NVIDIA has been tested. - 16 GB of RAM or more. A run uses about 10 GB. - About 60 GB free while building. - **Your copy of the game at the supported version:** program `0400486024DEC000`, update v131072, build `e0f3ccfa`. Other versions do not work. To build from the command line you also need: - Python 3 with `lz4`, `numpy`, `capstone`, `unicorn` and `zstandard`: `pip install lz4 numpy capstone "unicorn>=2.1,<2.2" zstandard` Use Python from python.org: the Microsoft Store's Python installs packages where `python -I` does not look. - The clang from [emsdk](https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk), at `C:\emsdk`. - Visual Studio 2022 with .NET 8, only if you want to change the builder itself. - The prebuilt tools that go in `third_party/`: `a64emit`, `lld-link`, `zbic` and SDL2. - What the HookshotBuilder zip carries in its `tools` folder and a clone does not. The builder sets the variables below itself; from the command line, set them before you run `make_game.py`: - `tools\cpm`: the Vulkan headers and FFmpeg. Set `RX_CPM` to this folder. Without it the build leaves out `hookshot_vk.dll`, the Vulkan renderer, and says nothing. - `tools\wgpu-native`: set `WGPU_NATIVE` to this folder. - `tools\third_party\sdl2\SDL2.dll`: copy it to `third_party\sdl2\`. - `tools\work`: copy it, with its `image` folder, to `work\`. It holds the hot-function list, the link order, the profile and the icon; without them the game builds but runs slower. ### What this does on your PC - The build reads your game and never changes it. It writes to the folder you choose and to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\HookshotBuilder`. - The romfs is hard-linked instead of copied where the disk allows it. - To uninstall, delete the game folder and `%LOCALAPPDATA%\HookshotBuilder`. ### If something goes wrong | Problem | What to do | |---|---| | "Hookshot supports build e0f3ccfa" | Check that you chose the right game with its update installed | | The game opens and closes | Update your graphics driver | | Stutter the first time you see something | Normal for now: shaders are being prepared. It gets better when you pass through the same place again | | The game is in the wrong language | Change the code in `language.txt` beside the game. The file lists them all | If the problem continues, report it with where you were in the game, your graphics card and a screenshot or video. Never send game files. ## In-game menu Press Insert in game. Everything is off by default, and your choices are saved in `hookshot_options.ini` beside the game. | Option | Choices | |---|---| | Frame generation | Off, 2x, 3x, 4x | | Frame pacing | Off, On | | Resolution | Auto (the game's own dynamic resolution), 100%, 75%, 67%, 50% | | Upscaling | Off, Catmull-Rom, Lanczos | | Sharpness | 0 to 100% | | Game speed | Per frame, Real time | | Handheld profile | Off, On | | Ultrawide | 16:9, Monitor's shape | | FPS counter | Off, On | With Game speed on Per frame, the game runs slower whenever it is below 60 fps. Real time keeps it at normal speed. ### Controls Use a controller, or the keyboard and mouse. On the keyboard, W A S D move and the arrow keys turn the camera. ## How it works 1. `nx2/lift.py` translates the game's ARM64 code to C. 2. `nx2/build.py` compiles that C together with `host/`, which plays the part of the console's system. 3. `host/nvn_native.c` records the game's NVN2 graphics calls, and `gpu/vk/` replays them on Vulkan. 4. Switch 2 Ampere shaders are lowered to Maxwell (`lower_to_maxwell.h`) and translated to SPIR-V by Eden's shader recompiler. More detail is in the [development guide](docs/development.md) and the [design notes](docs/design.md). ## Want to help? Testing on other graphics cards and reporting the result already helps a lot, and so does playing further into the game than anyone has yet. Bigger ways to help: - **Linux testing.** The Linux build (`host/posix`) has been tested on one PC so far: reports from other distributions and graphics cards help. - **Fixes in your own fork.** Fork the project, fix what you find and send the change back. Keep game files, keys and anything generated from your game out of it. ## Credits Hookshot exists thanks to the work of many people: - **NotRexed**: Hookshot, BlueShell (Mario Kart World), Skybound (Tears of the Kingdom) and the a64-kit tools. - **[Eden](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden)** and **Eglantine**: the shader recompiler and Switch 2 shader work. - **suyu**: the graphics decoders and the AArch64 translator. - **[seedds/nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)**: reference for how task and mesh shaders work. - **[zortos293/Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii)**: reference for Ampere shader lowering. - **[kinnay/zbic](https://github.com/kinnay/zbic)**, **Opus** and **SDL**: decompression, audio and controllers. - **[sostenesfreitas/ocarina-recomp](https://github.com/sostenesfreitas/ocarina-recomp)**: this README's layout, and its notes confirmed the mesh stage's control section. - **[MythosOfs/Orchid](https://github.com/MythosOfs/Orchid)**: the fog and exposure workaround for Ocarina of Time. - **Mesa (NAK)**: the reference for Ampere's instruction encoding. - Everyone who sent fixes: klimovich008, d3zessete, chrispository, vzeol, monsterlag and leonidasmark, among others. ## License Hookshot is free software under the [GNU General Public License, version 3 or later](LICENSE) (GPL-3.0-or-later). It includes code from Eden, suyu and Orchid, which are under the GPL too. Third-party parts under other licenses that work with the GPL (Sirit, the Vulkan Memory Allocator, SDL, Opus, stb, zbic and the a64-kit tools) keep their own notices in their folders. Hookshot is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. The Legend of Zelda and Ocarina of Time are trademarks of Nintendo.

items.name: GestaltX
items.description: An MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27.x, featuring region-code tweaks, device presets, backups, and support for 7 languages.
items.readme:
GestaltX

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.3-blue)](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-27.x-black?logo=apple)](#compatibility) [![SwiftUI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swift-SwiftUI-orange?logo=swift)](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPLv3-blue)](LICENSE) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README_ZH-CN.md) A MobileGestalt editor for iPhone and iPad. Developed by [huamidev](https://github.com/huamidev). ## Features | Category | Presets and tools | | --- | --- | | Display | Dynamic Island capability and layout, Always-On Display, AOD Vibrancy, Liquid Glass low-power rendering | | Device | Model name, boot/shutdown chime, charge limit, tap to wake, Camera Control settings, Action Button settings | | iPad | Apple Pencil settings, Stage Manager capability, iPad app compatibility | | Intelligence | Independent region-code options, Apple Intelligence capability flag, and sales-region options for activation attempts on China-mainland devices | | Advanced | Apple internal feature flags, internal storage view, Security Research Device flag | | Field editor | Read, search, add, edit, and remove `CacheExtra` fields; local plist import/export; String, Integer, Real, Boolean, Data, Date, Array, and Dictionary values | | Changes | Automatic reading and manual re-read, staged before/after review, verified writes, per-preset restore | | Backups | Automatic initial backup before device editing, backup before every write, original-value records; open, export, restore, and delete | | Logs & respring | Actual exploit-stage logs and manual NeoSpring respring | Usually, changing the region code is enough to try enabling AI; there is no need to change Sales Region. Selecting United States for Region Code sets `RegionCode` to `LL` and keeps the sales-region suffix. You can also choose China (Mainland), Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan or the United Kingdom. Sales Region and Region Code can be applied together: the sales suffix follows Sales Region, while the code follows Region Code. *If you previously changed Sales Region, restore your device’s original sales region and apply it first.* Disabling a preset or using its Revert button restores the recorded original values and types. Keys that were originally absent are removed. If an older change has no original record, use Remove Added Fields only when you know those fields were added. Presets modify capability flags; actual effects depend on the device and OS. China-mainland devices can use the Apple Intelligence and region options to attempt activation; availability also depends on the model, OS version, and Apple services. ## Compatibility Supports **iOS / iPadOS 27.x**. **iOS / iPadOS 26.x is not supported for on-device MobileGestalt access.** Powered by [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query). SystemGroup access requires iOS 27; available features depend on the device and OS. Local plist editing is also supported. Signing requires a certificate and provisioning profile with at least one usable App Group. Sign the app and its embedded share extension with at least one **common App Group**, and keep the extension when re-signing. Both processes detect their actual signed App Groups at runtime. ## Import a plist In Files or another app, select a MobileGestalt plist, tap **Share**, and choose **GestaltX**. The share extension reads the supplied file and hands it to the app through the shared App Group. Return to GestaltX if it does not open automatically. The app checks a device-bound proof from a GestaltX export, or at least two unique identifiers obtained from this device, then asks you to confirm the import. Files that cannot be verified are rejected. Previously imported files are never used as the reference for device identity. Some original plists contain no unique device identifiers. Export a copy from GestaltX on this device first: its verification key stays in the device-only Keychain and is never included in the file. Shared files are checked at launch and on return to the foreground. Pending edits are preserved until you save or discard them. Confirmed imports open as local documents. **MG Control** supports adding, editing, renaming and deleting typed keys and values. Use **Restore Imported Plist** to restore a verified file to this device; restoration requires a matching system cache layout and an additional confirmation, backs up the current file, and verifies the write. Restart the device afterward. ## Language support GestaltX follows your iOS language settings, with English as the default and fallback. Persian includes right-to-left layout support. | Language | Locale | | --- | --- | | English | `en` | | 简体中文 — Simplified Chinese | `zh-Hans` | | 繁體中文（台灣）— Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) | `zh-Hant-TW` | | 繁體中文（香港）— Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong) | `zh-Hant-HK` | | Tiếng Việt — Vietnamese | `vi` | | Русский — Russian | `ru` | | فارسی — Persian | `fa` | ## Credits - [forcequitOS / Taj C — worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) - [neonmodder123](https://github.com/neonmodder123) - [skadz108](https://github.com/skadz108) - [rooootdev — NeoSpring](https://github.com/rooootdev/neospring) - [Nouvborne — Ketamine](https://github.com/Nouvborne/Ketamine) - [PoomSmart — MGKeys](https://github.com/PoomSmart/MGKeys) - [leminlimez — Nugget](https://github.com/leminlimez/Nugget) - [rooootdev — mond](https://github.com/rooootdev/mond) - [frs0n — GestaltEdit](https://github.com/frs0n/GestaltEdit) ## Disclaimer For security research and educational purposes only. Use only on devices you own or are authorized to manage. Back up your data before making changes. Modifying MobileGestalt may cause system instability or require a device restore. You are responsible for the changes you apply and the resulting risks. ## License [GNU GPL v3](LICENSE) · Copyright © 2026 huamidev.

items.name: NX2navi
items.readme: # NX2navi **Join the official NX2navi update discord server: https://discord.com/invite/uf6gSrsPpq** **NX2navi** is a static recompilation of *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* for Nintendo Switch 2 (game version 1.1.1) into a native x86-64 application for Windows, with a Vulkan renderer ([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)). > [!IMPORTANT] > **No game files are included.** You need your own legally obtained copy of the game, dumped from your own console. > Instructions for obtaining those files will not be provided. > > The game is built from your files on your machine, so the result contains the game. It is for your own use. Do not share it. ## Status Early development, playable. Kokiri Forest, Kakariko Village, Death Mountain Trail and its crater, the Temple of Time and the Great Fairy fountains play at 60 fps and above on current GPUs, from the title screen and from saves. Visual bugs and occasional crashes are still expected ([Known issues](#known-issues)). Report problems as issues, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Features - Native code, not emulation - 60 fps by default, or a limit of 30 to 240 fps, the display's refresh rate or unlimited - Native widescreen and ultrawide (the window's shape, 21:9 or 32:9) with the HUD, menus and movies kept 16:9 - Game resolutions from 1080p to above the game's 1440p: 1800p, 4K, 5K or the window's own size, sharp on high-DPI displays - Upscaling and anti-aliasing: NVIDIA DLSS (DLAA, Quality, Balanced, Performance, Ultra Performance; RTX GPUs) or AMD FSR 3.1 (Native AA and the same modes; any GPU), which render the 3D scene at the mode's share and keep the HUD sharp; or AMD FSR 1 or bilinear scaling to the window, with a sharpness setting; black bars or stretch - Frame generation: NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation (RTX 40 and 50 GPUs, paced with Reflex) at 2x, or 3x and 4x on RTX 50 GPUs (one, two or three generated frames for every frame the game draws), or AMD FSR 3.1 (any GPU), a generated frame between every two the game draws, with the HUD kept out of it, for about twice the frame rate on a fast display; in a window of another shape than the picture, frames are generated inside the picture only, so the black bars stay clean. With frame generation on, the frame limit counts the frames on screen, and with no limit chosen it is the display's refresh rate. The frame limit can also be handed to RivaTuner Statistics Server - HDR on HDR displays: the game's own native HDR, or its SDR picture tone mapped to the display's peak, with exposure, highlights, shadows, contrast, saturation and gamma in the menu - The game's known shaders prepared when the game is built, and the pipelines met in play built again in the background at each start, so play rarely stops to compile them; a shader or pipeline met for the first time can still hold a frame, and a draw that must wait for its pipeline has it built on worker threads, never on the game's drawing thread - In-game settings menu (F1, or Minus and Plus together on a gamepad) and performance overlay (F10) - Keyboard, mouse and gamepads with remapping, Nintendo, Xbox or PlayStation button layout, rumble and gyro; the game follows whichever connected gamepad you press, and DualShock 3 controllers are read directly when enabled - Xbox, PlayStation and keyboard and mouse button prompts in the game's own text, drawn on your PC when the game is built; the keyboard prompts follow your key bindings - Stereo or 5.1 surround sound output, on the output device of your choice; the default microphone for the game's microphone input - The monitor the game opens on, straight in fullscreen when fullscreen is on - Your Discord status shows "Playing NX2navi" with the play time (on by default; the Game tab of the menu or the launcher's Settings turns it off) - Docked or handheld console mode - The game's textures stay compressed (BC3, about half the video memory at the same speed) unless the PC has 20 GiB of video memory and 48 GiB of RAM, as Windows counts video memory against the system's commit limit ## Installing Download `NX2navi-Setup-.exe` from the releases and start it next to your `.nup` dump. It is the only file you need. The launcher it installs finds the dump, downloads the build tools, builds the game on your PC (10 to 25 minutes, once) and starts it; afterwards it keeps the port up to date and rebuilds only what changed ([docs/launcher.md](docs/launcher.md)). [docs/README-BuildKit.md](docs/README-BuildKit.md) describes the same build by hand, [docs/building.md](docs/building.md) building from source. Settings are in the in-game menu and in `nx2navi.ini` ([nx2navi.ini.example](nx2navi.ini.example) lists every key). Controls: [docs/controls.md](docs/controls.md). Requirements: Windows 10 or later; an x86-64 CPU with SSE4.2 (AVX2/FMA machines get a faster build); 16 GB of RAM; about 30 GB free for the game and 1.5 GB for the launcher and its tools; a GPU with Vulkan 1.3, `VK_EXT_external_memory_host` and `VK_EXT_mesh_shader`. The setup is not signed, so SmartScreen warns on its first start. ## Known issues - The first start after an install or update, and the first visit to an area, can pause briefly while the graphics driver builds what it has not seen; later starts are smooth. - Machines with 16 GB of RAM can run out of system memory in Hyrule Field. - Integrated AMD GPUs can fail at the title screen (their host memory heap is too small for the game's memory). - A rare crash in the game's particle code. ## License The source is public to read. Its additions and changes are all rights reserved ([LICENSE-ADDITIONS](LICENSE-ADDITIONS)): no part of them may be copied or published without written permission. The base import stays under its [MIT License](LICENSE), and third-party code keeps its own license ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)). No license grants anything for Nintendo's game. NX2navi is an independent, non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. *The Legend of Zelda*, *Ocarina of Time* and *Nintendo Switch* are trademarks of Nintendo. ## Building from source [docs/building.md](docs/building.md) lists the toolchain and the steps. `tools/make_game.py` also builds the game natively on Linux ([docs/README-BuildKit.md](docs/README-BuildKit.md), "Linux"); the launcher and the setup are Windows only. Everything the build writes stays under `build\` and `generated\`, which git ignores; run `tools/check_content.py` before a commit.

items.name: S2Arm
items.description: Run your own Switch games natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: game code rewritten to ARM64, graphics direct to Metal, one app for the whole library. Bring your own games and keys. 把你自己的 Switch 游戏原生带到 iPhone / iPad / Mac。
items.readme:
**Your own Switch games, running natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac.** Game code is rewritten to native ARM64 and runs directly on the device's processor, with graphics going straight to Metal. Your whole library lives in one app, and a few clicks in the Mac or Windows launcher take a game from import to play. Platforms: iPhone / iPad (iOS / iPadOS 18 and later) · Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later) · Build on Mac or Windows · Android / HarmonyOS coming soon · License: Apache-2.0 · **Bring your own games** [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Download the launcher](https://jhaizhou-ops.github.io/S2Arm/) · [All releases](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/releases) · [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md)

## A native port, not an emulator The game's own ARM64 code is rewritten at build time and then runs directly on the processor in your iPhone, iPad or Mac. There is no CPU emulator in between. Graphics calls are translated straight to Metal, and system services come from a native host. That is where the speed, the low heat and the battery life come from. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#native-port) ## One app, your whole library Every game you import goes into the same S2Arm app; open it and pick what to play. The whole library takes a single App slot on your developer account, so adding a game never means installing another app or spending another signing slot. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#one-app-whole-library) ## Graphical launchers, next to zero setup There is a graphical launcher for Mac and one for Windows. On first launch the welcome page boils everything down to three steps: get this computer ready, add your keys, add your games, with a single primary button at any moment. Everything else is either bundled or fetched in one click, and you never touch a command line. After you click Build, every stage shows its progress, elapsed and remaining time, and disk use. Several games can queue up and build one after another. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#graphical-launchers)

## Let an AI drive Both the Mac and Windows launchers expose a control interface, `s2armctl`. An AI assistant can import games, build, install, follow progress and read errors, and every step shows up in the launcher window. A companion self-check, self-fix and feedback toolkit lets the AI find a problem, apply the documented fix, and, when it cannot, package a diagnostic bundle for you to file. Watch an AI diagnose and fix a real problem end to end: [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#ai-at-the-wheel) ### Have an AI do it for you Send this to your AI assistant (it needs to be able to run commands on your computer): > Please read https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/launchers/macos/skill/s2arm-operator/SKILL.md and then help me install my Switch game on my iPhone. It moves forward with a few commands, and you can watch every step in the launcher window: ```bash /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl start # open and connect to the launcher /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl next # what to do now, who does it, and why /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl diag export ~/Desktop/S2Arm-diagnostics.zip # export a diagnostic bundle if it cannot fix a problem ``` Anything only you can do (system permission prompts, signing in with your Apple ID, tapping Trust on your phone), the AI stops and asks you to do. On Windows, use `s2armctl.cmd` in the launcher folder with the same commands; exporting a diagnostic bundle is currently Mac-only. ## Tested at scale **211** games surveyed with a **95%** first-try build success rate. **4,700+** test runs on real iOS devices and **1,000+** on macOS. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#tested-at-scale) ## Fast, smooth, and easy on the battery On a 16 GB MacBook Air (M3), from importing a game to a finished iPhone build, completely cold: | Game | Game files | Shaders | Build time | |---|---|---|---| | A 23.5 GB action RPG | 23.5 GB | 1,222 | **6.4 min** | | A 12.0 GB life-sim game | 12.0 GB | 9,315 | **8.6 min** | | A 17.5 GB open-world game | 17.5 GB | 26,999 | **34 min** | A Switch 2 game, measured on an iPhone 17 Pro Max: a **full 60 fps** while the phone is cool, **37–43 fps** once sustained load has heated it up, at about **0.15 J per frame**. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#speed-and-efficiency) ## Platforms | Platform | Support | |---|---| | iPhone / iPad | iOS / iPadOS 18 and later; every game is chosen inside one app | | Mac | Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later; builds locally and plays games right on the Mac | | Windows | Graphical launcher that builds and installs games for iPhone / iPad | | Android / HarmonyOS | Coming soon | [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#platforms) ## Getting started 1. Download the Mac or Windows launcher from the [download page](https://jhaizhou-ops.github.io/S2Arm/) and open it. Building for iPhone on a Mac needs the free Xcode from the App Store, signed in with your Apple ID; the launcher walks you through it. 2. Import your own keys and games. Put the base game, updates and DLC in one folder and import them together. 3. Choose iPhone / iPad or this Mac, then click Build. 4. Follow the launcher to sign and install with your own Apple ID (the Windows launcher ships with the Impactor signing tool), open S2Arm, and pick a game from the library. Back up your saves before updating the app. The release uses the new app identifier `io.s2arm.*`, which the system treats as a new app: saves from the beta builds do not carry over automatically. ## Honest boundaries S2Arm runs 64-bit (AArch64) games. Apple silicon cannot execute 32-bit ARM code, so 32-bit games are outside what S2Arm supports, as are games that need a 36-bit address space. ## Development [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [AI collaboration policy](LLM_POLICY.md) · [Diagnosis and root-fix skills for AI](skills/) · [Report a problem](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/issues) · [Third-party licenses](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md) ## Thanks S2Arm stands on the shoulders of its community. - **Co-developers**: thank you to everyone who has opened a pull request or issue in this project. Your code, device testing and bug reports shaped S2Arm (in order of first contribution): [@biglawine](https://github.com/biglawine), [@yyan160](https://github.com/yyan160), [@DanielZhangyc](https://github.com/DanielZhangyc), [@vickwv](https://github.com/vickwv), [@Xc1Ym](https://github.com/Xc1Ym), [@fjack](https://github.com/fjack), [@ha7rock](https://github.com/ha7rock), [@yourmoonlight](https://github.com/yourmoonlight), [@qidian99](https://github.com/qidian99), [@n06ody](https://github.com/n06ody), [@YTwsy](https://github.com/YTwsy), [@wdjwxh](https://github.com/wdjwxh), [@realskyrin](https://github.com/realskyrin), [@wwmogu](https://github.com/wwmogu), [@quancunlau](https://github.com/quancunlau), [@moongrant](https://github.com/moongrant), [@imyinyx](https://github.com/imyinyx), [@s-leeq](https://github.com/s-leeq), [@Zhangbu](https://github.com/Zhangbu), [@retX0](https://github.com/retX0), [@zh0ngtian](https://github.com/zh0ngtian), [@fengbird](https://github.com/fengbird), [@zsakvo](https://github.com/zsakvo), [@1500256797](https://github.com/1500256797), [@BossaMelon](https://github.com/BossaMelon), [@GayoZhao](https://github.com/GayoZhao), [@sovaly](https://github.com/sovaly), [@ruterfu](https://github.com/ruterfu), [@fyn1320068837-source](https://github.com/fyn1320068837-source), [@InTheManXG](https://github.com/InTheManXG). - **Ryujinx** (Ryujinx Team and Contributors, MIT): upstream for system services and shader translation; S2Arm's compatibility layer is built on it. - **[NX2Apple](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)** (LNPANDY, MIT): upstream of the launcher interface. - **[nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)** (seedds, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 seedds): the original work behind the direct graphics layer that connects game graphics straight to Metal. # sheeridVerify · 教学与研究验证流程工作台

[![Tests](https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D22.15-43853d)](https://nodejs.org/) [![License: ISC](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-ISC-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**[sheeridVerify](https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify)** 是一个基于 Node.js 的验证流程学习项目，提供本地 Web 工作台、任务队列、浏览器表单交互及 HTTP 状态查询，供学校教学、学术研究和获得授权的流程测试使用。

> **用途说明：** 本项目仅以教学与研究为目的提供。使用真实平台前应取得必要授权，遵守适用法律和平台条款；不得伪造身份、学籍或材料，不得冒用信息、骗取权益或绕过资格审核。本项目与 SheerID 及任何学校均无官方隶属或认可关系，也不保证验证成功。详情见 [用途说明与免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)，代码许可见 [ISC 协议](LICENSE)。

## 文档导航

- [快速开始](#快速开始)
- [工作台与接口说明](#使用)
- [Linux / Instabox 部署、更新与排错](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)
- [浏览器流程说明](docs/browser-workflow.md)
- [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [安全说明](SECURITY.md) · [免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)

## 功能

- 通过 fetch 读取验证状态，按当前步骤选择浏览器或材料处理流程。
- 在 Web 页面创建、排队、停止、恢复和删除任务；失败任务删除后可重新提交。
- 按配置限制并发，记录任务进度，提交后默认每 5 秒查询结果。
- 上传原始 PNG、JPEG、PDF 文件，不生成或修改证明材料；交互式真人验证由用户完成。
- 使用访问密码、会话 Cookie、来源检查及写请求令牌保护工作台接口。

## 快速开始

需要 **Node.js >= 22.15** 与 npm。从 GitHub 获取源码：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify.git
cd sheeridVerify
```

使用下载的 ZIP 时，解压后进入其中包含 `package.json` 的目录。在项目根目录安装依赖与浏览器：

```bash
npm ci
npm run browser:install
```

首次使用时复制配置，已有个人配置请直接编辑原文件。

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
Copy-Item config/sheerid.example.json config/sheerid.local.json
```

Linux / macOS：

```bash
cp -n config/sheerid.example.json config/sheerid.local.json
```

编辑 `config/sheerid.local.json`，设置获授权的国家、学校、`data.organization.emailDomain` 和材料来源。该文件必须是标准 JSON，**不支持 `//` 注释或尾随逗号**。网页会按姓名和配置后缀生成邮箱，仅应使用自己有权使用的真实地址与资料。`document.path` 与 `document.url` 只能填写其中一个；示例配置不包含可直接提交的真实资料。

```bash
npm run web
```

打开 **http://127.0.0.1:8787**。本地默认访问密码为 `JenkinWoo`；对外开放前必须通过 `ONE_WEB_PASSWORD` 更换密码，并配置 HTTPS 入口。Linux 有界面浏览器需要可用桌面；完整部署步骤和环境变量模板见 [部署指南](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)。

## 测试与贡献

```bash
npm test
```

测试使用模拟接口及本地页面，不向真实验证接口提交数据。未安装 Camoufox 时会跳过浏览器相关用例；网页和浏览器改动应在安装浏览器后验证。GitHub Actions 在 Node.js 22、24 上运行不含已安装浏览器的测试。欢迎按 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) 提交问题和改进，报告前请删除个人资料、凭据及真实验证链接。

## 协议与责任说明

项目采用 [ISC License](LICENSE)，与 `package.json` 的协议声明一致。教学与研究是项目的预期用途，不额外收窄 ISC 的开源授权范围。软件按原样提供；第三方依赖和平台分别适用自己的许可和条款。请在使用前阅读完整的 [用途说明与免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)。

## 社区认可与致谢

本项目认可并支持 [LINUX DO 社区](https://linux.do/) 的开源分享精神，感谢社区为开发者提供技术交流、经验分享与开源项目展示的平台。欢迎在遵守社区规则的前提下交流使用体验与改进建议。

社区推广材料见 [LINUX DO 发帖草稿](docs/LINUX_DO_POST.md)，其中包含推广声明模板与 AI 辅助生成的项目介绍图片。

## 工作原理

当前命令行先用 Node.js 内置 `fetch` 查询状态，再选择执行流程：需要填写学生资料时使用 Camoufox，需要材料验证时使用纯 `fetch` 接口。材料上传保持文件原始内容，不生成或修改证明文件。

## 使用

### 本机 Web 工作台

```powershell
npm run web
```

打开 **http://127.0.0.1:8787**。页面填写验证链接、名、姓、出生日期、代理和访问密码。`url`、`firstName`、`lastName`、`birthDate` 必须由创建任务接口传入，缺少时拒绝入队。邮箱不再由前端传入，而是每次根据配置文件中的 `emailDomain` 域名后缀按 `First name + 点 + Last name @xxx.edu`（如 `first.last@xxxx.edu`）格式自动拼接生成。国家、学校、材料来源、浏览器、超时、邮箱后缀等设置，每次启动任务时从 `config/sheerid.local.json` 读取；提交值不会写回配置文件。当前配置及示例配置不再保存验证链接和个人信息。

`POST /api/jobs` 的 JSON 请求体示例（认证仍使用会话 Cookie 或 `X-Web-Password`，写请求携带 `X-Local-Token`）：

```json
{
  "url": "https://services.sheerid.com/verify/项目ID/?verificationId=验证ID",
  "firstName": "Test",
  "lastName": "Student",
  "birthDate": "2000-01-02",
  "proxy": ""
}
```

当前配置用于 Web/API 模式。若单独使用 CLI，需通过 `--config` 指定含验证链接及所需资料的独立配置；`document.url` 仍是材料下载地址，继续保留在配置中。

代理填写时使用输入的代理，留空或只有空格时强制直连，**不使用配置中的代理、系统代理或代理环境变量**。支持 HTTP/SOCKS5 URL 及 `host:port:username:password`。`AUTOMATION_URL` 也不会覆盖网页输入的链接。

点击“加入队列”后，按入队顺序自动填写、提交，并按配置继续材料流程；`browser.autoFill: false` 时遵循原有手动填写模式。材料来源沿用配置中的 `document.path` 或 `document.url`，下载查询中的姓名使用本次网页输入。点击提交后保留浏览器，只有接口确认进入 `docUpload` 且没有终止错误时，才关闭浏览器并继续上传文件。

并发上限由 `config/sheerid.local.json` 的 `web.concurrency` 控制，默认 1。例如同时执行 3 个任务：

```json
"web": { "concurrency": 3 }
```

并发数必须是正整数，服务启动和新任务入队时读取；调低上限不会中断正在运行的任务，后续等到名额足够再启动。排队任务保存入队时的配置快照。任务使用链接中的 `verificationId` 作为唯一 ID；服务本次运行期间重复提交同一 ID 只返回已有任务，不会重复执行。已停止的任务可以通过“恢复任务”明确重新加入队尾，沿用原资料、代理及配置，重复点击不会重复入队；成功或失败的任务不能通过该按钮重跑。

右侧列出队列，点击任务可查看对应进度和日志；刷新保留选中的任务。表单可连续添加不同任务。停止排队任务会立即取消；停止运行任务会终止后续操作，并在对应浏览器和连接清理完成后释放并发名额，随后才可恢复。恢复时先检查远端验证状态；尚未确认的提交继续只读查询。保留浏览器等待手动操作的任务仍占用名额。停止 Web 服务会取消所有排队和运行任务；队列与历史仅保存在服务内存中，重启后不自动恢复或重试。

Web 默认仅监听本机，不把完整配置返回前端，也不持久保存输入的个人资料和代理密码。提交后的审核等待会继续占用任务名额，直到成功、失败或手动停止。

页面选中失败、已结束或已停止的任务后，可点击“删除当前任务”，再用相同链接重新加入队列。删除最后一个任务会清空进度和活动记录，表单内容继续保留；运行中的任务需先停止并等待资源清理完成。

删除历史任务接口：`DELETE /api/jobs/:verificationId`。请求携带已验证的会话 Cookie 或 `X-Web-Password`，以及 `X-Local-Token`（先通过 `GET /api/session` 获取 `token`），无需请求体。已完成、失败或已停止且清理完资源的任务可删除，成功返回 HTTP 200 和 `{ "id": "verificationId", "deleted": true }`；排队、运行或正在停止的任务返回 HTTP 409 / `JOB_ACTIVE`，请先调用 `POST /api/jobs/:verificationId/cancel` 并等待停止完成；不存在的任务返回 HTTP 404 / `JOB_NOT_FOUND`。删除只移除本服务内存中的任务及活动记录，不撤销验证平台上的提交，也不删除磁盘运行日志。删除后相同 ID 可通过正常创建任务接口重新入队，仍先检查远端状态。

网页只在有排队、运行或正在停止的任务时自动刷新进度；全部任务结束并读取最终日志后停止轮询。加入、恢复或切换任务会重新读取状态；已停止任务不会被反复查询。空闲页面要查看其他页面新建的任务时，刷新网页即可。

首次状态分流和浏览器启动前的检查遇到网络错误、超时或 HTTP 5xx 时最多尝试 3 次，重试间隔按 `polling.intervalMs` 递增（默认 5 秒、10 秒），等待可随任务停止而取消。HTTP 4xx（含 429）及无效响应在初始检查中直接停止。网页将状态查询失败、网络/代理异常、请求限流与真正的验证拒绝分别显示，避免把连接失败误报为“验证失败”；这些重试只用于只读状态查询。

### 提交后的状态跟踪

自动提交资料或材料后，程序继续通过 fetch 查询状态，默认每 5 秒一次。`pending`、`emailLoop` 都是中间状态，不结束任务；邮件步骤仍需用户完成邮件操作。正常提交流程最终返回 `verified`（成功）或 `failed`（失败），手动停止仍显示“已停止”。若只是查询现状，`npm run status` 仍只请求一次。

服务端重新返回 `docUpload` 且没有终止错误时，重新请求 `document.url` 获取当前原始文件（仍携带本次姓名），重新申请上传地址并提交；本地文件则重新读取。不会复用上次文件字节或上传地址。`rejectionReasons` 是退回材料的原因，`currentStep: error` 或非空 `errorIds`（包括 `docReviewLimitExceeded`）会终止失败。

可设置 `"polling": { "intervalMs": 5000 }`，范围 1000–300000 毫秒。审核没有人为设置的总等待超时，可通过停止按钮或 Ctrl+C 取消。查询暂时断网、超时或 HTTP 5xx 时退避重试；HTTP 429 仅在带 `Retry-After` 且没有终止错误时按指示等待。上传/提交响应丢失时先持续只读查询，不直接重放写请求；确认已进入审核后，才允许处理后续新的补交材料要求。不可恢复的接口/材料错误会标记任务失败；`submissionUncertain` 表示服务端结果尚未确认。

端口占用时使用 `npm run web -- --port 8788`。关闭服务按 Ctrl+C；不要关闭服务终端后继续操作 Web 页面。

### instabox 部署

程序目录为 `/data/workspace/one`，使用 Node.js 22+，运行 `npm ci` 和 `npm run browser:install` 安装依赖及对应平台的 Camoufox。Linux 有界面浏览器使用 `DISPLAY=:1`，可在 instabox 的 Computer 标签中查看和操作；个人配置仍使用 `config/sheerid.local.json`。

公网部署设置 `ONE_WEB_HOST=0.0.0.0`、`ONE_WEB_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://你的域名`，可用 `ONE_WEB_PASSWORD` 覆盖默认访问密码 `JenkinWoo`。不再使用 `ONE_WEB_USER` 或 HTTP Basic 登录；网页可直接打开，在表单的“访问密码”中输入密码即可。API 校验密码或会话 Cookie，并继续检查来源和写请求令牌。公网必须使用 HTTPS 入口；未配置监听环境变量时仍只监听本机。密码校验成功后设置 HttpOnly、SameSite=Strict 的会话 Cookie（公网额外设置 Secure），刷新页面无需重复输入；服务重启后需重新验证。

直接调用接口时，向 `GET /api/session` 发送 `X-Web-Password: JenkinWoo`（自定义密码时替换），保存返回的 `token`。后续 API 请求携带该密码头或返回的会话 Cookie；创建、停止、恢复、删除任务还需携带 `X-Local-Token: token`。默认密码仅存在于后端，页面不会预填密码。

`deploy/one-web.service` 可安装到 `~/.config/systemd/user/one-web.service`，凭据环境文件使用 `/data/workspace/one/.env.web`（权限 600）。使用 `systemctl --user enable --now one-web` 启动；修改代码后执行 `systemctl --user restart one-web`，日志使用 `journalctl --user -u one-web`。停止服务会结束任务；服务重启后队列为空。服务器重启后需保持用户服务运行，并在启动浏览器任务前确保 Computer 桌面可用。

### 命令行

要求 Node.js >= 22.15。默认读取 `config/sheerid.local.json` 的验证链接和材料来源；下载网络材料时可使用配置中的姓名查询原始文件。

```powershell
# 按状态分流：需要资料时打开浏览器并填写，但不提交；其他状态只报告
npm start
# 始终只查询状态，不开浏览器、不上传
npm run status

# 按当前状态提交：资料步骤走浏览器，材料步骤上传指定文件
npm run submit -- --file "C:\Documents\student-proof.png"

# 网络材料地址：保留引号，避免查询参数中的 & 被 shell 解析
npm run submit -- --url "https://school.example.edu/proof?id=123"

# 使用独立配置文件
npm run submit -- --config config/documents.local.json --file "C:\Documents\student-proof.pdf"
```

`--file` 和 `--url` 二选一，均覆盖配置中的材料来源。配置中可填写 `document.path`（本地路径）或 `document.url`（HTTP/HTTPS 地址），不能同时填写两个非空值；配置好后可直接使用 `npm run submit`，无需每次指定路径。旧的 `document.path` 配置继续有效。所有相对路径以启动命令时的工作目录为基准，Windows JSON 路径需写成双反斜杠或使用正斜杠。只有状态允许材料提交且指定了提交模式时才读取或下载材料，完整读取并通过检查后才发起任何验证状态写操作。

最小配置参考 `config/documents.example.json`：

```json
{
  "app": "sheerid",
  "url": "https://my.sheerid.com/rest/v2/verification/REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_VERIFICATION_ID",
  "document": { "path": "C:/Documents/student-proof.png" },
  "timeouts": { "apiMs": 20000, "downloadMs": 120000, "uploadMs": 120000 },
  "artifactsDir": ".runs"
}
```

使用网络材料时，将上面的 `document` 替换为：

```json
"document": { "url": "https://school.example.edu/proof?id=123" }
```

地址须直接返回原始 PNG、JPEG 或 PDF 内容。支持查询参数和内网 HTTP/HTTPS 地址；运行脚本的电脑必须能访问它。下载不携带浏览器 Cookie 或登录凭据，返回登录页、HTML 或 JSON 时会停止，不会继续上传。不会生成或修改材料内容。

配置了 `data.firstName` 和 `data.lastName` 时，下载 `document.url` 或 `--url` 会将去除首尾空格的姓名用一个空格连接，以 URL 编码写入 `name` 查询参数；例如 `?page=2` 变为 `?page=2&name=First+Last`。原有其他参数保留，已有 `name` 会替换为当前配置的姓名，用于查询对应的原始材料。独立材料配置未提供姓名时保留原地址；只提供部分姓名则停止下载并提示补全。本地文件不受影响，日志不记录姓名或完整下载地址。

URL 也可使用原来的 `https://services.sheerid.com/verify/<programId>/?verificationId=...` 页面链接。`AUTOMATION_URL` 环境变量可以覆盖 URL。每次从 URL 读取验证 ID，不在代码中写死。

支持 HTTP、HTTPS 和 SOCKS5 代理，包括账号密码认证。在本地配置增加顶层 `proxy`：

```json
"proxy": {
  "server": "http://proxy.example.com:8080",
  "username": "YOUR_USERNAME",
  "password": "YOUR_PASSWORD"
}
```

SOCKS5 使用 `"server": "socks5://proxy.example.com:1080"`，账号密码字段保持同样格式；无认证代理可省略这两个字段。也可将 `proxy` 写为字符串：`"http://user:password@host:port"`、`"socks5://user:password@host:port"`，或服务商提供的 `"host:port:username:password"`（未指定协议时默认 HTTP）。URL 中的特殊凭据字符需百分号编码；推荐使用分开的字段，避免手动编码。`sock5://` 兼容为 `socks5://`。

`AUTOMATION_PROXY` 环境变量可覆盖配置，格式与代理字符串相同；为空时使用配置。

未配置代理时（省略 `proxy`、`null`、空字符串，或 `server`/`username`/`password` 全为空的对象）默认使用当前系统代理：依次读取 `HTTPS_PROXY`、`ALL_PROXY`、`HTTP_PROXY` 环境变量（大小写均可），再读取 Windows“设置 → 网络 → 代理”中已启用的手动代理（注册表 `ProxyEnable`/`ProxyServer`，分协议设置时优先 https，其次 http、socks）。系统代理关闭或未设置时直连。不支持 PAC 自动配置脚本和系统代理的排除列表。需要强制直连时设置 `"proxy": "direct"`（或 `false`）。仅填写账号密码而不填 `server` 仍会报 `INVALID_PROXY`；系统代理地址无法解析时报 `INVALID_SYSTEM_PROXY`。示例配置不包含真实凭据。

浏览器页面的 HTTP/HTTPS 请求、状态预检查、远程材料下载（含重定向）、上传及提交接口共用该代理配置；本机回环材料地址直接访问本机服务。带认证的 SOCKS5 经仅监听 `127.0.0.1` 随机端口的本机转接服务供浏览器使用，远程 `fetch` 使用同一转接服务；代理不可用时请求失败，不自动改为直连。任务结束时释放连接和转接端口，保持浏览器窗口期间也保持代理服务。这个设置不是系统级 VPN；开启代理后，非回环内网材料地址也经上游代理访问，需要上游能访问该地址。不会自动更换账号中的会话参数或探测出口 IP。

需要自动打开表单时，必须提供完整验证页面链接和所需个人资料；只有状态接口 URL 无法确定对应的页面地址，会报告 `FORM_URL_REQUIRED`。Web/API 模式的页面链接、姓名、邮箱、出生日期来自创建任务请求；当前 `config/sheerid.local.json` 只保留其余设置。独立 CLI 材料配置用于只查状态或处理材料步骤。

默认入口先查询一次状态选择分支，各执行器获得任务锁后再查询一次。`npm run submit` 点击提交后保留浏览器，通过 fetch 跟踪状态；接口尚未离开资料步骤或暂时不可用时继续等待，不重复点击提交。只有接口明确返回无终止错误的 `docUpload` 才关闭浏览器并转交文件上传；SSO 转入材料步骤时也等待该接口确认。尚未出现上传步骤的待审核、邮件状态继续保留浏览器。提交模式成功、终止失败或手动停止时仍清理浏览器，不因 `keepOpen: true` 保留窗口。上传交接时日志记录 `browser_closed` / `DOCUMENT_HANDOFF`，任务锁和代理保留到最终结果。结果中的 `documentRunId` 关联材料流程记录。`npm start` 仍只填写，按 `keepOpen` 保留窗口；`npm run status` 只查询一次。

如果表单已经提交并进入材料步骤，可直接运行 `npm run submit -- --file ...` 或 `--url ...`，程序按最新状态上传，不重复填写表单。材料地址中的 `localhost`、`127.0.0.1` 和 `[::1]` 直连运行脚本的电脑；其他地址按配置使用代理，重定向后重新判断连接方式。

有界面模式使用跟随窗口尺寸的视口，调整或最大化窗口时不会继续固定使用生成的视口尺寸。下拉框按实际就绪状态操作：字段可用后，等待唯一匹配的选项出现、稳定且可点击，点击后确认菜单关闭和选中值，再填写下一项。国家选择会清空搜索过滤，并兼容国家代码、英文及中文页面标签，避免将 `United States` 当作中文选项的搜索词；月份也按页面语言匹配。学校搜索仍使用配置中的学校名称，不自动选择第一条结果。

慢网络下，每次候选项选择最多等待 `timeouts.readyMs`（默认 120000 毫秒），等待期间每 10 秒输出 `waiting_for_options`。需要更长等待可将该值设为 `180000`，最大 `300000`。等待超时或未确认选中会停止后续填写，并按原 `browser.keepOpen` 配置保留窗口；随机输入延迟不替代数据加载等待。

学校选项在异步刷新期间消失、替换或暂时不可点击时，会在同一等待期限内重新定位。每次点击检查和点击各最多等待 1.5 秒，短暂超时不会立即结束整个流程。点击尝试后先检查是否已选中；仅在菜单仍明确展开且目标选项重新就绪时重试选择，不重新输入搜索词或重开已关闭的菜单。等待日志中的 `code` 区分 `OPTIONS_LOADING` / `OPTIONS_RELOADING`（加载或刷新）、`OPTION_STABILIZING`（等待稳定）、`OPTION_CLICK_PENDING` / `OPTION_CLICK_RETRY`（点击阶段）、`OPTION_COMMIT_PENDING`（等待选中确认）。确认超时单独报告 `OPTION_NOT_COMMITTED`，不再误报成点击失败。这些重试仅用于选择表单选项，不用于表单提交或材料上传。

学校搜索输入完成后，若候选列表连续 5 秒保持不变、没有加载提示且没有匹配校名，会移到输入末尾删除一个字符，重新触发搜索，并记录 `SEARCH_RETRIGGERED`。同一次学校选择最多执行一次，仍使用原有的总等待期限及完整校名/校区匹配规则。正在加载、已尝试点击选项、输入内容被用户修改或输入框不可编辑时，不删除字符。

填写不再无限等待全部外部图片和 iframe 触发 `load`：打开页面后最多等待 15 秒 `load` 事件（超时记录 `page_load_slow` 并继续），然后要求国家、姓名、邮箱控件真正渲染完成——不透明（未处于淡入阶段）、未被加载遮罩覆盖、可用，且位置连续 1 秒不变——才开始填写；每个字段填写前也需稳定 300 毫秒。`waiting_for_fields` 日志中的 `NOT_PAINTED`、`COVERED`、`<settling>` 分别表示控件尚透明/隐藏、被遮挡、正在等待布局稳定。选中确认只检查该控件及其关联菜单，避免页面其他组件的加载标记造成无关等待；日志中的 `OPTION_MENU_OPEN`、`OPTION_VALUE_MISMATCH`、`OPTION_VALIDATION_PENDING` 分别表示菜单尚未关闭、显示值不匹配、控件校验尚未完成。

SheerID 选择学校后会将搜索输入框替换为只读学校文本框，原搜索框 ID 不再保留。学校分支优先识别这个已选控件，核对只读状态、完整学校/校区名称及校验状态；确认稳定后继续填写姓名等字段，不再等待已被移除的搜索框。仅输入了搜索文字仍不算选中。

浏览器启动时排除 Camoufox 自带的 uBlock Origin，减少验证资源被扩展拦截的可能性。填写完成后统一等待提交按钮：按钮禁用、被遮挡或页面显示“正在确认您是真人”时等待；出现“无法确认您是真人”和可用的“重试”按钮时点击重试，同一次运行最多 3 次。每次重试先等待加载结果，不连续点击；若错误提示始终未变化，至少间隔 5 秒才再尝试。第 3 次后再次失败，返回 `failed` / `HUMAN_VERIFICATION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED`，不提交表单。错误提示消失本身不算成功，必须等提交按钮可点击且没有验证加载/错误提示。

等待总预算由 `timeouts.humanMs` 控制，默认累计 180000 毫秒，最多可配置为 300000 毫秒；填写结束和提交前共用预算及重试计数，不会各自重试 3 次。持续加载或按钮始终不可点击时，达到预算即失败，即使尚未用完 3 次重试。日志每 10 秒报告等待原因，每次重试记录 `PAGE_RETRY_1_OF_3` 等计数。交互式真人验证由用户在浏览器中完成，脚本不会操作挑战内容。`npm start` 填写并等待按钮就绪后结束自动操作，仍不点击提交；只有提交模式会在就绪后提交一次。失败后按原 `keepOpen` 配置保留窗口。

## 状态与接口顺序

浏览器出现 “We couldn't continue your verification”（或对应中文标题 / `#sid-step-error` 错误页）时，立即按终止失败处理：`status: failed`、`code: VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE`，退出码 1。页面检测覆盖表单等待、填写、真人验证重试及提交后的结果等待；即使已经点击过提交，明确的错误页也不会被记成结果未知。不会点击该错误页上的 “Try again”，也不会新建验证会话；它与可重试三次的内联真人验证错误是两种状态。窗口仍按原 `keepOpen` 配置保留。

每次运行先请求 `GET https://my.sheerid.com/rest/v2/verification/{id}`，核对返回 ID、步骤和错误码。

| 当前状态 | 提交模式的行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `sso` 且无错误 | 先读取本地材料或下载网络材料并检查，再 `DELETE /step/sso`；仅当返回 `docUpload` 且无错误时继续 |
| `docUpload` 且无错误 | 读取本地材料或下载网络材料并检查，进入上传流程 |
| `collectStudentPersonalInfo` 且无错误 | 打开浏览器填写；`npm run submit` 还会点击提交，`npm start` 仅填写；不在这个步骤调用取消 SSO 或上传接口 |
| `success` | 返回 `verified`，不重复提交 |
| `pending` / `emailLoop` | 持续查询；邮件步骤等待用户完成邮件操作 |
| `error` 或非空 `errorIds` | 提交模式返回 `failed` 并停止，包括 `fraudRulesReject` |
| 未知步骤 | 提交模式返回 `failed` / `UNSUPPORTED_VERIFICATION_STEP`；只查状态仍报告 `not_actionable` |

上传流程为：

1. `POST /step/docUpload`：发送文件名、MIME 类型和实际字节数。本地来源使用原文件名；网络来源按内容命名为 `document.png`、`document.jpg` 或 `document.pdf`，不把查询参数带入文件名。
2. 从响应中的唯一文档记录获取 `uploadUrl`，验证它是 HTTPS S3/SheerID 地址。
3. `PUT uploadUrl`：发送原始文件字节及对应 `Content-Type`，不用 multipart，不附带 SheerID Cookie 或认证头。
4. PUT 成功后，`POST /step/completeDocUpload`，按接口返回的最终步骤记录结果。

支持本地和网络 PNG、JPEG、PDF，按文件头识别格式。本地来源还检查扩展名、普通文件类型及读取前后大小一致性；网络来源不依赖 URL 扩展名或响应文件名，下载时按实际接收字节累计检查大小，因此没有 `Content-Length` 也受限制。材料必须非空且不超过项目的 20 MiB 上限；这不是对服务端文件大小限制的保证，也不判断材料的真实性。网络读取仅在内存中缓冲，不另存到磁盘。

官方接口依据：[SheerID OpenAPI](https://services.sheerid.com/rest/v2/swagger.yaml)。其中 `DELETE /verification/{id}/step/sso` 的说明是取消 SSO 并转入 `docUpload`；并非跳过最终学籍审核，也不适用于尚在填写资料的步骤。

## 运行与结果

需要手动填写时，在本地配置的 `browser` 中设置 `"autoFill": false`，然后运行 `npm start`。默认值为 `true`，改回即可恢复自动填写。手动模式仍按当前验证状态决定是否打开表单；表单打开后跳过资料校验、字段等待、自动填写、真人验证重试及自动提交，保持窗口供你操作，关闭窗口或 Ctrl+C 后清理任务。需要 `headless: false` 且不能设置 `keepOpen: false`；此模式仅在资料填写步骤拒绝 `--submit`。手动提交进入材料步骤并关闭旧任务窗口后，可用 `--submit` 上传材料，无需重新开启自动填写；`--status` 仍只查询状态。

手动模式结果为 `status: manual` / `code: MANUAL_MODE`，只表示已打开页面交给用户，不表示填写完成或验证通过。后续手动填写、提交及验证结果以浏览器页面为准，`submissionAttempted` 只记录脚本是否提交。该开关不关闭网页自身的 JavaScript。

启动预检查或写请求遇到 HTTP 429 时仍报告 `API_RATE_LIMITED` 并停止。提交后的只读轮询仅在有 `Retry-After` 且响应未包含终止错误时等待并重试；没有恢复时间或已达到业务限制则失败，不连续重试。

状态和材料接口均通过 `fetch`。写请求不直接自动重试；只读轮询和服务端新要求的补交材料按上述规则处理。状态和上传接口不跟随重定向。网络材料下载最多跟随 3 次 HTTP/HTTPS 重定向，禁止 HTTPS 降级到 HTTP，不接受 URL 内嵌账号密码；超时覆盖整个下载和重定向过程。API 默认超时 20 秒，下载和上传各默认 120 秒，可分别配置 `timeouts.apiMs`、`timeouts.downloadMs` 和 `timeouts.uploadMs`。Ctrl+C 取消当前任务并释放任务锁。

标准错误输出阶段日志；标准输出返回最终 JSON。`.runs/<runId>.json` 保存状态、阶段和错误码，不保存材料字节、文件路径、材料源 URL、预签名上传 URL 或完整接口响应。每次远端写入前仍保存 `submission_unknown` 作为崩溃恢复记录；正常运行时响应丢失会继续只读查询，最终记录成功或失败。服务退出后不会自动重放未确认的提交。

材料分支结果中的 `remoteWriteAttempted` 记录是否已进入远端写入流程，`submissionAttempted` 记录是否进入完成上传请求；`browserOpened` 为 `false`。浏览器分支的 `submissionAttempted` 表示是否尝试点击提交，`browserOpened` 表示是否已创建浏览器会话。`pending` 表示等待审核，只有接口返回 `success` 才记录 `verified`。

| 结果 | 退出码 |
| --- | --- |
| `filled` / `verified` / `manual` | 0 |
| `failed` / `rejected` | 1 |
| `document_required` / `sso_required` / `personal_info_required` / `email_required` / `human_verification_required` / `pending` / `not_actionable` | 2 |
| `submission_unknown` | 3 |
| 用户中断 | 130 |

同一验证 ID 使用同一任务锁，包含与历史浏览器流程之间的互斥。旧浏览器任务仍运行时，应先正常关闭该任务。配置 `*.local.json`、`.runs/`、`documents/` 均被 Git 忽略。

```javascript
});
```

网络来源在上面的调用中用 `url: 'https://school.example.edu/proof?id=123'` 替换 `file`。统一分流库入口为 `runWorkflow(config, { submit, statusOnly, file, url, signal })`；这里的 `url` 是材料地址，验证地址仍由 `config.url` 提供。直接调用 `runDocumentWorkflow` 则始终只使用材料接口，遇到资料填写步骤返回 `personal_info_required`。浏览器分支调用 `runAutomation`，只有需要表单时才由 CLI 延迟加载 Camoufox；原随机输入、保持窗口和指纹配置仅作用于浏览器分支。更多浏览器设置见 [docs/browser-workflow.md](docs/browser-workflow.md)，历史命令说明以本 README 为准。

运行 `npm test` 可执行离线回归测试，覆盖浏览器到材料流程的衔接、任务锁、上传响应丢失、下载姓名参数及本机材料下载。有已安装的 Camoufox 时还会运行学校搜索的本地测试页；没有时跳过这些浏览器用例。测试不访问真实验证接口。

items.description: the ultimate vocal synthesizer - sing, speak, beatbox, and more
items.readme:
# CHIMERA

A physical-modeling voice synthesizer in the browser. Every sound comes from a simulated
airway (lungs, vocal folds or syrinx, a branched vocal tract, lips, nose), not from samples.
The engine is Rust, compiled to WebAssembly for an AudioWorklet; the same code runs natively
for tests and the `chimera` CLI.

## Vision & scope

1. **One instrument**: a physically modeled voice (lungs, vocal folds, throat, mouth). No
   samples, no neural audio.
2. **The web app is the primary surface**: anyone should be able to make songs in it without
   an LLM's help. Mobile is the likely next surface. The plugin (CLAP/VST3/AU) still ships, but
   it's secondary.
3. **More realistic without losing what it is**: the robotic, primitive sound people like today
   stays available, and every realism change is checked by ear against it.
4. **Languages enter through one shared front-end design**, not one-off hacks. Each needs a
   native speaker's check and must leave English unchanged.
5. **The design language (the vector display) is settled**; the look within it can still evolve.
6. **Nothing copyrighted in git**; MIT; a deterministic, real-time-safe engine.
7. **Not now**: a DAW or sequencer, a light theme, MPE, multi-voice dialogue.

## What it does

- **Play**: drag the tongue, lips and jaw in a live cutaway of the head; vowel pad, encoders,
  computer keyboard and Web MIDI.
- **Speak**: English text (CMUdict with a letter-to-sound fallback) or IPA, turned into
  gestures and prosody, with the gestural score and a consonant chart on screen.
- **Sing**: piano roll with lyrics per note; consonants land before the beat.
- **Beatbox**: pads and a step sequencer, every drum an articulatory gesture.
- **Bestiary**: songbird (two-voice syrinx), seal, alligator and elephant.
- **Duet** (`?show=<id>`): two 3D heads replay a pre-rendered song.

Male, female and child bodies blend continuously. Everything on screen animates from live
engine state: pressure in the airway, airflow, the vocal folds, spectra and formants.

## Run it

Needs Rust with the `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target, and Bun.

```sh
bun install
bun run dev        # builds the wasm, then Vite on 127.0.0.1:5317
bun run test       # wasm build, cargo test --workspace, bun test tests
```

The AudioWorklet needs a secure context, so open it on localhost or over HTTPS (for example
`tailscale serve`). Vercel builds it with `vercel.json`.

Offline renders and measurement:

```sh
cargo run --release -p chimera-cli -- render speech|text|song|notes|beatbox|creature|vowels …
cargo run --release -p chimera-cli -- diagnose       # nasal leakage, formants, bandwidths, pitch
cargo run --release -p chimera-cli -- compare csd    # against a real singer (docs/csd-comparison.md)
cargo run --release -p chimera-cli -- compare tsp    # against 23 real speakers (docs/speech-comparison.md)
bun tools/spectrogram.ts in.wav out.png
bun tools/musicxml-to-notes.ts score.mxl P1 --out p1.json   # a score's part → `render notes` melody
```

## Docs

- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): the acoustic model (FDTD airway, sources,
  anatomy, gestures), and its [references and credits](docs/architecture.md#references-and-credits).
- [docs/rust-engine.md](docs/rust-engine.md): the engine's real-time and determinism contract,
  and the browser boundary.
- [docs/ui-redesign.md](docs/ui-redesign.md) and [docs/mockups/](docs/mockups/): the vector
  display look.
- [docs/csd-comparison.md](docs/csd-comparison.md): scoring the voice against the Children's
  Song Dataset.
- [docs/speech-comparison.md](docs/speech-comparison.md): scoring the speech against real
  speakers, phone by phone (the TSP speech database).
- [docs/hill-climb/](docs/hill-climb/): the rules and log for tuning the voice one measured
  step at a time.

Agents: see [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Bundled third-party files keep their own licenses: the CMU Pronouncing
Dictionary ([public/data/CMUDICT-LICENSE.txt](public/data/CMUDICT-LICENSE.txt)) and the fonts
([public/fonts/](public/fonts/)).

items.description: Monitors your RAM and reports any "quite terrible" unused capacity directly to the CEO of OpenAI.
items.readme:
# Ram-Altman

**A bash script that writes to Sam Altman once a day to report the RAM he missed.**

Read the sample emails at **[ram-altman.lol](https://ram-altman.lol)**, no install needed.

[![Website: ram-altman.lol](https://img.shields.io/badge/website-ram--altman.lol-0f5a43)](https://ram-altman.lol)
![Global DRAM allocation: quite terrible](https://img.shields.io/badge/global%20DRAM%20allocation-quite%20terrible-red)
![Utilization: maybe 5%](https://img.shields.io/badge/utilization-maybe%205%25-orange)
![Emails: 1 per day](https://img.shields.io/badge/emails-1%20per%20day-blue)
![Written in Bash, not Electron](https://img.shields.io/badge/written%20in-bash%2C%20not%20electron-brightgreen)

There is RAM in your computer. Right now. Just sitting there, in a *personal* computer, being personal.

You may have thought of this as "a computer working normally". On a recent episode of [Cheeky Pint](https://gizmodo.com/sam-altman-youre-completely-right-about-ram-im-sorry-for-the-confusion-heres-what-happened-2000835208), the CEO of OpenAI offered another view:

> "From a global allocation perspective, actually, it's quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world's limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer"
>
> — Sam Altman

That RAM, he added, is ["being used maybe 5% of the time"](https://www.xda-developers.com/sam-altman-says-its-quite-terrible-that-people-have-ram-in-their-pcs-during-a-shortage/).

Which raised an obvious question for a certain kind of person: *surely someone should be monitoring this?*

So we wrote a script. If your machine has more than 10% of its RAM available, it sends one email a day to let Sam know. It seemed only fair. He can't fix the problem if nobody tells him where the RAM is.

## Features

- Tracks total, used and available RAM, plus your standing with the global allocation authorities
- Handles page cache correctly, which already puts it ahead of most arguments about RAM
- Sends at most one email per day, because we're hoarders, not animals
- Rotates 8 subject lines, 10 messages and 6 sign-offs, so the joke gets old at a carefully managed pace
- Logs every sample to CSV for when the auditors arrive
- Ships with 14 tests, more than the DRAM market has had sensible outcomes
- Is written in bash, as an Electron version would have solved the problem by using all the RAM

## A sample of today's correspondence

```text
Subject: You missed a spot

Hi Sam,

Please don't be alarmed, but there is 8.6 GiB of RAM on my desk that isn't in
a data centre. That's 56.2% of what's installed here, and as far as I can tell
it has no plans today.

Hoarding responsibly,
A concerned RAM owner

--
Sent automatically, at most once a day, by a small script on one PC.
Reply if you'd like it to stop.
```

The figures are real. They come from your machine. That's the worrying part.

## What counts as "used"?

```text
used = MemTotal - MemAvailable
```

`MemAvailable` is the kernel's own estimate of how much memory programs could claim without swapping. Free RAM counts as available. So does cache the kernel can reclaim. tmpfs and shared memory don't, because they can't simply be handed back.

Every sysadmin has spent years explaining that [Linux didn't eat your RAM](https://www.linuxatemyram.com/) and that free RAM is wasted RAM. It took decades for someone important to agree with the second part, and he'd like it shipped to him.

Strictly speaking, the page cache is doing useful work, so counting it as available is a generous concession to the other side. Think of it as a plea bargain.

On kernels older than 3.14, which have no `MemAvailable`, the script estimates it from free memory plus reclaimable cache. If you're on one of those, your RAM may be safe. Nobody's coming for that.

## Installation

You'll need Linux, bash, and a working `sendmail`, `msmtp` or `mail` command. Your RAM is assumed.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/IainKay/ram-altman.git
cd ram-altman
chmod +x ram-altman.sh test-ram-altman.sh

./ram-altman.sh --status    # see the evidence against you
./ram-altman.sh --dry-run   # preview an email without sending it
```

Example output, from a simulated machine that has confessed to everything:

```text
Total:      15.3 GiB
Used:       6.7 GiB
Available:  8.6 GiB (56.2%)
  Free:     0.3 GiB
  Cache:    8.2 GiB
```

To run it for real, add this to your crontab with `crontab -e`:

```cron
RAM_ALTMAN_TO=recipient@example.com
RAM_ALTMAN_FROM=you@example.com
RAM_ALTMAN_FROM_NAME=Your Name

*/5 * * * * /path/to/ram-altman.sh
```

It samples every five minutes and emails at most once a day. If a send fails, it tries again on the next run, because this message matters.

| Setting | What it does | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RAM_ALTMAN_TO` | Who receives the bad news | Required |
| `RAM_ALTMAN_FROM` | A real address you can send from | Required |
| `RAM_ALTMAN_FROM_NAME` | Your name, or your nom de RAM | Optional |
| `RAM_ALTMAN_THRESHOLD` | Email when available RAM is above this percentage (whole number) | `10` |
| `RAM_ALTMAN_STATE_DIR` | Where the log and state files live | `~/.local/state/ram-altman` |

## Audit yourself

Let it run for a while, then find out how your machine compares:

```bash
awk -F, 'NR>1 { used += $3; total += $2 }
  END { if (total) printf "Your RAM in use: %.1f%% (the claim: maybe 5%%)\n", used * 100 / total }' \
  ~/.local/state/ram-altman/usage.csv
```

Yes, share of memory in use isn't the same thing as share of time spent in use. If you came here to say that, welcome to Hacker News. We're glad you're here.

## Please be a good neighbour

One email a day from one person is a joke. Ten thousand of them is a denial-of-service attack with better material.

- **`--dry-run` is the best way to enjoy this.** It costs nothing and all the jokes are there.
- **This repo doesn't ship with anyone's email address,** and please don't add one.
- **Use your own real address.** No spoofing, and no running it across your server fleet.
- **If anyone asks you to stop, stop.** The footer of every email promises this, so keep the promise.

You can also point it at someone who will enjoy it, like the friend who has been waiting for DDR5 prices to come down.

## FAQ

**Does this help with the DRAM shortage?**
No.

**Is this a serious tool?**
The memory accounting is. The correspondence isn't.

**Does it work on macOS?**
No, it reads `/proc/meminfo`. On the other hand, your RAM is probably soldered down, which makes you the hardest target in the global allocation programme.

**Why is the threshold 10%?**
Below that, your machine has suffered enough.

**Does running this use RAM?**
Briefly. It's then returned to the global pool, which is more than can be said for the rest of us.

**Can I run the tests without emailing anyone?**
Yes. `./test-ram-altman.sh` uses simulated memory and a fake `sendmail`. No inboxes are harmed.

**Can I see it without installing anything?**
Yes. [ram-altman.lol](https://ram-altman.lol) cycles through the real emails, with sample figures.

**What should I do with all this RAM?**
Open another browser tab. You've still got time.

## In fairness to Sam

Altman has since [said the remarks were taken out of context](https://gizmodo.com/sam-altman-youre-completely-right-about-ram-im-sorry-for-the-confusion-heres-what-happened-2000835208), writing:

> "i actually do want the world to have tons of memory and people to put as much as they want in their computers"

He [followed up](https://www.gadgetreview.com/sam-altman-says-he-wants-you-to-have-even-more-ram-not-less-changes-name-to-ram-altman) with "i want you to have so much ram" and "lets build more", and briefly changed his display name on X to Ram Altman, which is objectively excellent and is where this project gets its name.

The original remarks [came up in a discussion of running AI models locally](https://www.engadget.com/2303266/sam-altman-says-its-terrible-dram-computer/), and the utilization argument is a real one: servers really are busier than your desktop. We just think it's funnier to reply with cron.

Besides, if he wants you to have so much RAM, then this script isn't a complaint at all. It's a daily progress report.

## License

Free as in unallocated.
